data.headline: High-complexity claims take substantially longer to settle independently of notification and prior-claim history
data.interpretation: Claims with complexity_score >= 4 average 35.5 days to settle versus 23.6 days for lower-complexity claims (Cohen's d 1.29, 2.29x standardized effect, p<0.001, n=2,824). The difference remains after stratifying by notification_channel (adjusted d 1.30) and prior_claims (adjusted d 1.30), with neither confound explaining the effect. Complexity is therefore a strong settlement-speed driver as well as a leakage-risk marker.
